name: Waiting Upon God
overview: Scripture reveals that waiting upon God is an active, hopeful trust in His salvation and guidance, exemplified by David and other faithful servants. The psalmist encourages believers to wait with integrity and courage, confident that God will strengthen their hearts and teach them His truth throughout the day. This waiting is not passive but marked by a steadfast expectation of God's deliverance and faithfulness, as expressed in the longing for salvation and the assurance that those who wait on the Lord will not be put to shame.
